manual.title: Add a printer manually
manual.description: No printer was recognised by its Bluetooth name ({count} other devices are visible). Pick the device and tell Home Assistant which model it is — Marklife printers have no model-ID query, so the model cannot be detected once the name does not match.

data_description.model: Pick the family your printer belongs to. The listed name prefixes show which models each profile covers.

abort.not_supported: This device does not look like a Marklife printer.
abort.unsupported_transport: This Marklife model uses Bluetooth Classic (SPP) or a proprietary transport. Home Assistant's Bluetooth stack and ESPHome Bluetooth proxies are BLE-only, so it cannot be controlled from Home Assistant.

error.invalid_address: That is not a valid Bluetooth address.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read battery and status. Each poll opens a BLE connection, and an ESP32 Bluetooth proxy has only three connection slots.
data_description.keep_connection: Holds the BLE connection open between jobs, trading a proxy connection slot for a faster first print. Leave off unless you print often.
data_description.tick_ms: Minimum gap between packets. Leave at 0 to use the value from the device profile — 30 ms for most models, 1 ms for M60/X2. Only raise this if prints come out banded.
data_description.starvation_ms: How long to wait for a flow-control credit before forcing one through. Raise this first if labels print partially or stop midway; over a Bluetooth proxy the credit notification takes an extra network hop.
data_description.packet_size_cap: Upper bound on packet size, whatever the printer's MTU says. Lower it if raising the starvation timeout did not help.

print.name: Print label
print.description: Render a payload and print it on a Marklife label printer.

width.name: Width
width.description: Canvas width in pixels. Defaults to the printer's print head width (384 dots on most models).

density.name: Density
density.description: Print darkness (1 to 3). Defaults to the device profile.

paper_type.name: Paper type
paper_type.description: 'gap' advances to the next die-cut label; 'continuous' feeds a fixed distance.

copies.name: Copies
copies.description: How many identical labels to print.

preview.name: Preview only
preview.description: Return the rendered label as a base64 data URL instead of printing it.
